title: SGE review record
description: One machine-readable record per merged PR, written by /sge:pr-review at verdict time to .sge/review-records/<pr>.json on the PR branch: what was checked, by what, and who decided. The human decision is a reference to evidence the agent cannot write, never free text. Cross-field rules (a T2 PR, or a declared T2 floor, needs a github-review decision; the file name must match pr) are enforced by validateArtefacts in scripts/artefact-schemas.mjs. sge#3322, ADLC epic sge#3320.

pr.description: Pull request number. Must equal the number in the file name.

issue.description: Issue the PR closes or implements.

spec_id.description: SPEC-NNN the change is governed by, or "none" when governance-trace classed it spec-less.

resolved.description: Tier the resolver derived from the diff.

declared_floor.description: Floor a trusted human declared at intent; the resolver may raise the tier above it, never lower it.

depth.description: Review depth, for example light or full.

policy_checks.description: Names of the policy checks that ran.

model_id.description: Exact model id that produced the verdict, pinned.

kind.description: github-review for T2 (review_id required); sampled or auto for T0/T1.

review_id.description: GitHub pull request review id (API), evidence the agent cannot write. Required when kind is github-review, forbidden otherwise.
